technique_name: Explain the difference between acute stress and chronic stress.
description: Acute stress is an intense, short-term reaction to a stressful event. It is generally resolved once the threat passes or a person is able to successfully manage the event. Chronic stress, on the other hand, is a prolonged and constant strain that results from ongoing difficult life situations, such as poverty and homelessness, or daily annoyances like a high-pressure job.
